title: Chapter 267 The Dreamland
content:
Chapter 267 The Dreamland

At this moment, Wang Hao only felt like he was dreaming.

Although he is not an alchemist, he also admires Shi Liantian in his heart.

After all, elixirs are basically something that a cultivator can eat.

"Little girl, how are you good now?"

Looking at Yuanyuan, Wang Hao didn't know what to say, but in the end he gave a symbolic greeting.

"The teacher is very good."

Hearing this, Yuanyuan nodded.

"Okay, just be OK."

Wang Hao smiled awkwardly and didn't ask any more questions.

Although he was a little curious about Shi Liantian's sudden disappearance in the fairy world, he still didn't ask.

On the one hand, this may be Shi Liantian’s privacy.

On the other hand, Wang Hao felt that although the girl in front of him was Shi Liantian's apprentice, he might not know what happened back then.

The five people kept breaking through the space tunnel and heading towards the Tiandi Academy.

Along the way, no one spoke again.

I don't know how long it took.

As a space in Tiandi Academy cracked.

Five figures walked out of the crack in the space.

"You guys go back first, I still have something to do."

After saying this, Wang Hao rushed towards the direction of the Academy's Council Hall.

Place, Lu Xue and the other two looked at me, I looked at you.

Qin Feng spread his hands and said that he knew nothing.

"I'm going to stay in seclusion for a while and then leave first."

At this time, Lu Xue spoke.

Then he pulled Yuanyuan towards Zhuyun Peak.

Looking at Lu Xue's departure back, Xiao Luo was slightly stunned, and then quickly waved and said, "Sister Xue, wait for me!"

Xiao Luo was about to chase after him, but Qin Feng grabbed him from behind.

"Well, Brother Qin, what do you mean?"

Xiao Luo looked puzzled.

Qin Feng smiled meaningfully and said, "Brother Xiao, I have a good place, I wonder if you are interested?"

Upon hearing this, Xiao Luo's expression moved slightly.

"Oh? Brother Qin, please tell me quickly, Xiao listened carefully."

Immediately, Qin Feng pressed against Xiao Luo's ear and his lips moved slightly.

After a moment, Xiao Luo nodded directly.

"go!"

"Since you can improve your strength, it's not bad to sacrifice a little."

Seeing Xiao Luo agreeing decisively, Qin Feng became solemn.

"Okay, Brother Xiao is really a model change for us. Since that's the case, then let's go now!"

"What should I do if Sister Xue?"

"Sister Xue?"

Qin Feng was slightly stunned, then waved his hand and said, "Sister Xue is going to go into seclusion, it's just right. When her seclusion is over, we will almost come out."

Hearing this, Xiao Luo pondered for a moment and nodded.

Immediately, the two of them stopped talking and went straight toward the depths of the academy.

As the powerful force known as the richest resources in the Immortal Realm, Tiandi Academy naturally has a large number of cultivation sites.

Including some rare trial secret realms.

One of the most famous trial secret realms is called the Dream Secret Realm.

In it, there will be many undescribable transactions.

It extremely tests the stability of the heart of Tao.

Once the flaws in the Taoist heart are too big, they may sink into it.

However, if you can pass, it will not only improve your own talent and qualifications, but also make the heart of Tao more stable.

In this way, almost before the Dream Secret Realm is opened, a large number of students from Tiandi Academy will apply to enter.

Of course, one of the main reasons why the Dream Secret Realm is so popular among students of Tiandi Academy is that a certain student met after entering. . .

Since then, countless students, especially male students, have begun to charge towards the mysterious dream.

And now, it is the time when the Dream Secret Realm is opened.

"Senior, Tianjian Peak disciple, Qin Feng, apply to enter the Dream Secret Realm."

In a deep valley, there was only an old man wearing a straw hat lying half here.

The whole valley is extremely quiet.

Hearing this, the old man reached out and raised his straw hat slightly, took the token of Tianjian Peak disciples handed over by Qin Feng. Then, the old man looked at Qin Feng again and chuckled, "Can you bear it with this little body? ? ”

Hearing this, Qin Feng's face turned slightly red, he coughed lightly, and said, "Senior, don't worry about this, the student is sure."

At this time, Xiao Luo also handed the token to the old man.

"Senior, Zhuyun Peak disciple, Xiao Luo, apply to enter the Dream Secret Realm."

"Zhuyun Peak."

The old man took the token and murmured, his eyes lit up slightly.

"Go."

The old man waved his hand gently, and the space behind him suddenly began to buzz.

The next moment, a time and space tunnel suddenly opened.

Seeing this scene, Qin Feng and the others looked at each other and nodded.

"Let's go."

"good."

Immediately, the two of them were about to enter.

And at this moment, the old man suddenly looked moved.

Buzz —

Another space tunnel suddenly opened in another deep valley, not far from Qin Feng and the others.

"That's, exit!"

"Someone is coming out!"

Qin Feng said in surprise.

Hearing this, Xiao Luo stopped immediately and hurriedly walked towards the space tunnel.

I saw a young figure crawling out from it, then lying on the ground, without any movement.

"Senior, this,"

Qin Feng and the others quickly looked at the old man beside him, their eyes were extremely shocked.

This dream secret realm is indeed well-known.

However, what the two of them did not expect was the old man just glanced at the person lying on the ground, then half lay down again, and directly covered his straw hat on his face.

Obviously, the old man is used to this kind of thing.

"Forehead,,"

"Qin Feng, what should I do now?"

Xiao Luo said hesitantly.

Hearing this, Qin Feng looked at the space tunnel that was not closed behind him, and then looked at the person lying on the ground in the distance.

After pondering for a while, Qin Feng finally said, "Go and have a look."

If the old man didn't care, it means that the person was fine, but it was nothing to go and see. Maybe he could learn some lessons.

Rising experience or something.

Xiao Luo did not refute this, and the two walked towards the distance.

"Hey, brother?"

Qin Feng stepped forward and pulled the man lying on the ground, then turned him over.

"Oh, damn it!!"

The next moment, Qin Feng exclaimed in surprise and his body retreated repeatedly.

"What, what happened to you, Brother Qin?"

Xiao Luo, who was standing beside him, was startled by Qin Feng's sudden reaction.

Qin Feng's fingers trembled and pointed at the man on the ground tremblingly, "You, look."

Xiao Luo's eyes moved down.

"Damn!"

Suddenly, Xiao Luo also quickly took two steps back, his eyes extremely shocked.

I saw that the man on the ground had thin face, deep dark circles of eyes were filled with darkness, and the Yintang was black, as if he had been in for countless nights.

The strangest thing is that the man still had a happy smile on his face, saliva flowing from the corner of his mouth, and his eyes were dull.

"This, Qin, Brother Qin, what should I do?"

Xiao Luo was a little panicked and became a little afraid of the dream secret realm.

At this time, Qin Feng took a deep breath and said in a deep voice: "Don't panic, isn't it just a secret realm? Why should I be afraid of it?"

He took out a recovery pill and stuffed it into the mouth of the man on the ground. Qin Feng turned around and headed towards the dream entrance in the distance.

When she was still there, looking at Qin Feng's back, Xiao Luo seemed to be infected.

After a moment of silence, Xiao Luo hurriedly followed.

"Come in, I'm a sword cultivator, are you still afraid that the Taoist heart will be unstable?"

Qin Feng stood in front of the entrance and spoke confidently.

Xiao Luo also nodded and said, "As a member of the Xiao clan, how could he be afraid?"

In this way, the two of them had ambitions and resolutely stepped into the mysterious dream realm.

Buzz —

The space fluctuated and the two disappeared.
